name: TrainingLoadAcwrPlanner
tagline: Session RPE load, ACWR, monotony and the weekly plan – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete training load and periodisation app for strength & conditioning coaches and sport scientists. Session RPE × duration load, rolling or EWMA acute:chronic workload ratio with sweet-spot and danger zones, monotony, strain and weekly spikes; a week planner with each athlete's target range and projected end-of-week ACWR, group sessions and copy-a-week; squad comparison and athlete charts. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, with demo data out of the box.
features: Session RPE × minutes load (or external load column)
Rolling or EWMA ACWR with configurable zones
Monotony, strain and week-on-week change alerts
Projected end-of-week ACWR and target range per athlete
Plan sessions for athletes, groups or whole squads with live ACWR preview
Status rules: completed, modified (reason), missed, cancelled, reopen
Bulk complete as planned, mark missed, export CSV
Power Fx outputs and events, undo and history
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
controlType: standard (React 16.14.0 bundled; data-set control + Power Pages field control)
